changelog:
- Initial release of douyin-comment-to-demo-clip skill.
- Turns Douyin comment objections into a short talking demo clip per user-provided still (2–15 seconds each).
- Guides users to collect required inputs: comment lines or post link, product/demo facts, at least one image, and usage consent.
- Provides clear workflow for planning, lookup, voice cloning, speech synthesis, and clip animation—each with pricing and approval checkpoints.
- Ensures strict data and workflow handling (input inspection, credit quoting, no unauthorized cloning or video).
- Routes adjacent requests and clarifies out-of-scope actions (e.g., does not post on Douyin, invent data, or stitch clips).
summary: Turn Douyin comment objections into one comment talking clip per still. This douyin comment demo studio writes a speakable demo talking clip from each seller-picked objection, then animates a 2 to 15s objection demo clip. Use it for comment demo video and a douyin objection video that stay one photo, one clip.
